title: Playing at a hall on Napoleon and Tchoupitoulas; Tin Roof
summary: They played Wednesday, Friday and Sunday at a hall near Napoleon and Tchoupitoulas whose name neither can recall; Russell asks about Albert Burbank and the Tin Roof.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played
